collection.prefix_policy: Follow a shortest maze route towards the closest outside ghost until the first native life loss. Prefer an immediately fatal legal action when available. This deliberate perturbation is not the teacher and is never labelled.
collection.quality_scope: Apply every per-game gate to all teacher-controlled suffix decisions, including subsequent native lives. Full-game metrics also retain the intentional prefix death. Never drop failed teacher games.
collection.sampling: Every fourth teacher-controlled move plus danger, frightened, adjacent power and late-maze states. Seeded within-episode shuffle, then interleave all four levels and both modes.

split_policy: Disjoint episode seeds and exact input hashes. Benchmark, teacher development and qualification seeds excluded. Same classic maze, levels 1,2,3,5; no unseen-layout claim.

teacher.optimality: Empirically qualified finite-horizon policy portfolio; not globally optimal or universally safe.

coverage_audit.method: Coverage recomputed from selected inputs and verified native action events. Collection-mode counters are namespaced separately from post-respawn state flags. Question/state/label bytes and native trajectories are unchanged. The exact original generating source is archived with generator_sha256.
